headline: Quiet Fronts Reawaken as the Casualty Storm Broadens
war_summary: Since the last edition, the flag war has broadened. The Weathered Expanse, silent through the morning, has resumed its struggle: Wardens are credited with eight captures in the day's tally, Spirit Watch and Necropolis have seen the heaviest work, and two-hour losses approach a thousand men a side with hourly rates still climbing. Linn Mercy's flags have turned again, movement logged at the filing hour with Outwich Ranch the busiest post. Marban Hollow, lately still, stirs anew at Checkpoint Bua, while Stonecradle, absent from previous reports, shows six flag events in two hours about The Dais. Nor have the old storms spent themselves: Callums Cape counted more than four thousand two-hour losses, its hourly rates accelerating, and Mooring County ran heavier yet, the two fronts together logging more than sixty flag changes in the day. The Nevish Line remains flag-silent since early morning despite a day's toll near twelve thousand, and Callahans Passage has logged no movement since the previous evening. It is the 790th day of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
